name: Alpha Pokemon
rulesText: Add 2 to the Attack Strength of the attached Pokemon's Moves. (This effect doesn't apply to Moves with 0 Attack Strength. A Move's Attack Strength can't exceed 4 in this way.)

bonuses.condition: Does not apply to Moves with 0 Attack Strength. Attack Strength cannot exceed 4 with this bonus.

name: Poke Picnic
rulesText: While this card is attached to a Pokemon, it gains a +1 bonus to its Attack Total.

name: Red Orb
rulesText: While this card is attached to Groudon, it can Evolve into Primal Groudon. When this card becomes unattached, Primal Groudon reverts to Groudon.

name: Blue Orb
rulesText: While this card is attached to Kyogre, it can Evolve into Primal Kyogre. When this card becomes unattached, Primal Kyogre reverts to Kygore.

name: DNA Splicers
rulesText: While this card is attached to Reshiram, Zekrom, or Kyurem, the attached Pokemon can Evolve. Reshiram can Evolve into White Kyurem; Zekrom can Evolve into Black Kyurem; Kyurem can Evolve into either White Kyurem or Black Kyurem. When this card becomes unattached, the Pokemon reverts to its original state.

name: Zygarde Cube
rulesText: While this card is attached to Zygarde, when you roll the Movement Die during your Movement Phase and get 5 or higher, you may Evolve Zygarde into its next form.

name: Prison Bottle
rulesText: While this card is attached to Hoopa, it can Evolve into Hoopa Unbound. When this card becomes unattached, Hoopa Unbound reverts to Hoopa.

name: N-Solarizer
rulesText: While this card is attached to either Solgaleo or Necrozma, the Pokemon can Evolve into Dusk Mane Necrozma. When this card becomes unattached, the Pokemon reverts to its original state.

name: N-Lunarizer
rulesText: While this card is attached to either Lunala or Necrozma, the Pokemon can Evolve into Dawn Wings Necrozma. When this card becomes unattached, the Pokemon reverts to its original state.

name: Ultranecrozium Z
rulesText: While this card is attached to Necrozma, it can Evolve into Ultra Necrozma. When this card becomes unattached, Ultra Necrozma reverts to Necrozma.

name: Rusted Sword
rulesText: While this card is attached to Zacian, it can Evolve into Crowned Sword Zacian. When this card becomes unattached, Crowned Sword Zacian reverts to Zacian.

name: Rusted Shield
rulesText: While this card is attached to Zamazenta, it can Evolve into Crowned Shield Zamazenta. When this card becomes unattached, Crowned Shield Zamazenta reverts to Zamazenta.

name: Reins of Unity
rulesText: While this card is attached to Glastrier, Spectrier, or Calyrex, the attached Pokemon can Evolve. Glastrier can Evolve into Ice Rider Calyrex; Spectrier can Evolve into Shadow Rider Calyrex; Calyrex can Evolve into either Ice Rider Calyrex or Shadow Rider Calyrex. When this card becomes unattached, the Pokemon reverts to its original state.

name: Adamant
rulesText: Once per Battle, if this Pokemon would Faint due to the opponent Pokemon having a higher Attack Total, ignore all Attack Totals during the current Battle Round, resolve any remaining steps, then begin a new Battle Round.

name: Bashful
rulesText: If this Pokemon would Faint when the opponent Pokemon's Attack Total exceeds its own by at least 4, you may switch this Pokemon for any Pokemon of a higher Level on your team. No Pokemon Faint during this Battle Round. You may only do this once per Battle.

name: Bold
rulesText: This Pokemon gains a +1 bonus to its Attack Total against any Pokemon whose Level is at least 2 higher than its own.

name: Brave
rulesText: When this Pokemon uses a Move during the Battle Round which immediately follows one of your Pokemon Fainting, it gains a +2 bonus to its Attack Total.

name: Calm
rulesText: As long as this Pokemon does not have a Status Condition, it gains a +1 bonus to its Attack Total.

name: Careful
rulesText: If this Pokemon defeats a Wild Pokemon, add 2 to your Catch Roll when you attempt to Catch that Pokemon.

name: Gentle
rulesText: If this Pokemon defeats a Wild Pokemon and its Attack Total exceeds that Pokemon's Attack Total by no more than 2, add 2 to your Catch Roll when you attempt to Catch that Pokemon.

name: Hardy
rulesText: As long as this Pokemon has a Status Condition, it gains a +1 bonus to its Attack Total.

name: Hasty
rulesText: In each Battle, during the first Battle Round that this Pokemon participates in, its chosen Move gains [priority].

name: Impish
rulesText: When this Pokemon defeats an opponent Pokemon and its Attack Total exceeded the opponent's Attack Total by at least 3, it gains a +1 bonus to its Attack Total for the rest of the Battle. This applies only once per Battle.

name: Jolly
rulesText: When you roll the Movement Die during your Movement Phase and get a 6, you may move up to 1 additional space.

name: Lax
rulesText: If a Move Effect of the opponent Pokemon would give this Pokemon the Paralyzed Status Condition, treat the result of the Effect Die roll as though it were 1 lower. While Paralyzed, roll [d6] instead of [d4] when resolving the effect on side 1 of the Status card.

name: Lonely
rulesText: When this Pokemon is the only Pokemon on your team to participate in a non-Wild Encounter Battle, it gains a Level if you win that Battle.

name: Modest
rulesText: When a Move used by this Pokemon would give the opponent Pokemon a Status Condition, treat the result of the Effect Die roll as though it were 1 higher.

name: Naive
rulesText: If a Move Effect of an opponent Pokemon would give this Pokemon the Confused Status Condition, treat the result of the Effect Die roll as though it were 1 higher. While Confused, this Pokemon gains a +2 bonus to its Attack Total.

name: Naughty
rulesText: When this Pokemon defeats an opponent Pokemon and its Attack Total exceeded the opponent's Attack Total by at least 5, it gains a +2 bonus to its Attack Total for the rest of the Battle. This applies only once per Battle.

name: Perfect IVs
rulesText: This Pokemon gains a +1 bonus to its Attack Total.

name: Quiet
rulesText: This Pokemon gains a +1 bonus to its Attack Total when it uses an Effective Move against an opponent whose Level is higher than its own.

name: Quirky
rulesText: When this Pokemon uses a Move, roll the Effect Die. If the result is 1, it suffers a -1 penalty to its Attack Total. If the result is 6, it gains a +2 bonus to its Attack Total.

name: Rash
rulesText: If this Pokemon has defeated an opponent Pokemon already during this Battle, it gains a +1 bonus to its Attack Total.

name: Relaxed
rulesText: If a Move Effect of an opponent Pokemon would give this Pokemon the Sleep Status Condition, treat the result of the Effect Die roll as though it were 1 higher. During Sleep, the Typeless Move it uses has an Attack Strength of 2.

name: Sassy
rulesText: If a Move Effect of an opponent Pokemon would give this Pokemon the Burned Status Condition, treat the result of the Effect Die roll as though it were 1 lower. When a Move used by this Pokemon would give the opponent Pokemon the Burned Status Condition, treat the result of the Effect Die roll as though it were 1 higher.

name: Serious
rulesText: If a Move Effect of an opponent Pokemon would give this Pokemon the Confused Status Condition, treat the result of the Effect Die roll as though it were lower. While Confused, treat this Pokemon's chosen Move's Attack Strength as 1 less when adding it to the opponent Pokemon's Attack Total.

name: Timid
rulesText: In Battle, if this Pokemon participates in the first Battle Round, it suffers a -1 penalty on its Attack Total until another one of your Pokemon has participated. If this Pokemon first participates in a Battle after another Pokemon on your team has done so, it gains a +1 bonus to its Attack Total.
